🎞️ MOVIES
♟️

Searching for Bobby Fischer ⭐

1993

A kind boy who learns to think ahead. My favorite lesson: kindness is strength.

Trailer
🕶️

The Matrix

1999

The world is not always what it seems. Wake up, ask questions, and choose your own life. The movie that changed movies forever.

☀️

The Sun Is Also a Star

2019

One single day can change a whole life. Natasha has only hours to save her family, and fate puts Daniel in her path. Coincidence... or was it written in the stars? A movie for believing…

Trailer
🎺

Born in East L.A.

1987

Cheech Marin gets deported by mistake to a country he doesn't even know — and he never loses his heart or his humor. Dignity is something nobody can take from you. Laugh with this one.

👻

Ghostbusters: Afterlife

2021

A family discovers the secret life of the grandfather they never really knew. Love doesn't end — it gets passed down. Fun like the movies you love, with a big heart underneath.

🥦

In Defense of Food

2015

My doctor pick for you — a documentary with one simple, true idea: eat food, not too much, mostly plants. Taking care of your body is taking care of your life, and this one explains it…

⏳

Looper

2012

A man comes face to face with the person he used to be — and the person he could still become. Our choices echo. One brave choice can break a whole cycle.

🃏

Molly's Game

2017

A true story from my world — poker. Molly builds her own empire from nothing, and when everything is on the line she protects her people and keeps her integrity. That's real power.

🥋

The Karate Kid

1984

An old teacher and a patient student. 'Wax on, wax off' — the small things you do every day become your strength. That's how masters are made, in karate and in life.

🐎

Let It Ride

1989

Richard Dreyfuss gets the one perfect day at the racetrack every gambler dreams about. Joy, luck, and believing a bad run can turn around — pure fun from my world.

🐕

Finch NEW

2021

Gary saw this one himself and loved it. A man who knows his time is short builds a robot to care for his dog when he is gone — and teaches it what love means. With Tom Hanks.

Trailer
🔮

Devs · 2020

This one is a series — eight episodes — and I loved it: from the maker of Ex Machina, a secret tech division builds a machine that can see everything, past and future, and it asks the biggest…

📓 PEN15 · 2019 · TV series

Middle school, exactly as it was — Maya and Anna play their 13-year-old selves next to real kids. Season 1 complete (10 episodes) and Season 2 is up to episode 7 — every episode is on the queue inside the theater, and the folders live in the vault.
